title: Make DaemonProxy stream-pair handling consistent before unavailable fallback
outcome: DaemonProxy has one consistent supplied-stream contract independent of whether startup reaches relay or the unavailable fallback; partial pairs cannot cause a fallback-only unhandled ArgumentException.
acceptance: A focused regression exercises input-only and output-only calls through DaemonProxy.RunAsync, including pre-relay failure, and demonstrates consistent validation at entry or documented per-side normalization; neither/both-stream controls preserve existing relay and typed-unavailable behavior.

completion.summary: Confirmed with four RED actual-proxy cases and fixed by validating the stream pair at RunAsync entry. Focused 19/19 and complete parent gates pass; complete Codex6664/Claude6665 full-union review CLEAN. Four optional Low follow-up tasks recorded, one false-positive isolation finding rejected with source evidence. No commit or push.
